title: Gate evaluation under coordinate embedding
statement: Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $G$ be an AND or OR gate, let $e:\	ext{Fin}(m)\hookrightarrow\text{Fin}(n)$ be an injective coordinate map, let $v:\text{Fin}(m)\to\{\pm1\}$ assign signs to the smaller coordinate set, and let $S\subseteq\text{Fin}(n)$. Extend $v$ to the larger coordinate set by assigning the neutral sign of $G$ outside the image of $e$. Then evaluating $G$ on the preimage of $S$ under $e$ with values $v$ gives the same sign as evaluating $G$ on $S$ with this extended assignment.
hypotheses_covered: Choice of an AND or OR gate
Injective map from Fin(m) to Fin(n)
